description_en: Queries the custom upgrade and release batches of the current user
description_zh: 查询当前用户自定义升级发布批次
name: ListPublishBatch

parameters.help_en: The target version to upgrade to
parameters.name: upgrade_version

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page when paging is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示每页数据的最大条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the release batch
parameters.name: batch_name

BatchList.description_en: The details of the batch release tasks
BatchList.description_zh: 批量发布任务的详细信息

items.description_en: The details of the batch release tasks
items.description_zh: 批量发布任务的详细信息

BatchId.description_en: The ID of the release batch

BatchInterval.description_en: The interval between the completion of the current batch and the start of the next batch. Unit: hours
BatchInterval.description_zh: 本批次发布完成之后间隔多长时间发布下一批次，单位：小时

BatchName.description_en: The name of the release batch

BatchNo.description_en: The number of the current batch in a phased release
BatchNo.description_zh: 分批发布时当前批次号

BatchProcess.description_en: The release progress of the current batch, indicating the number of machines that have been released
BatchProcess.description_zh: 当前批次的发布进度，已发布多少台机器

BatchTotal.description_en: The total number of batches in the release

OperationBase.description_en:
The dimension for asset selection. Valid values:

0: machine instance
1: machine group
2: VPC-connected instance ID
OperationBase.description_zh:
资产选择维度。取值：

0：机器实例
1：机器分组
2：VPC实例ID

Status.description_en:
The release status of the client. Valid values:
0: not started
1: releasing
2: release completed
3: release paused
4: force upgrading
Status.description_zh:
客户端发布状态。取值：
0： 未开始
1： 发布中
2： 发布完成
3： 发布暂停
4： 强制升级中

Version.description_en: The target version to upgrade to

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page when paging is used
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page when paging is used
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，显示的每页数据的最大条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The China Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
